identity.product_outcome: An evidence-bound catalog topology and qualitative A&R prioritization kernel that keeps readiness, blockers, artist intent, identity fit, catalog relation and target fit semantically distinct.
identity.artist_job: Compare Songs and decide what to finish, hold, rewrite, group, prepare, pitch or investigate next without fabricating hit probability, market certainty or artistic-quality scores.

bounded_increment.description: Preserve the two-file catalog-topology reasoning foundation while the independently owned Windows reliability and Steward integration dependencies remain unresolved.

semantic_contract.required_behavior: Prioritize exact Song candidates using source-bound qualitative evidence with explicit staleness, conflict and provisional inference while preserving semantic ties and refusing numeric market/artistic certainty.
non_negotiable_semantics: READINESS, BLOCKER, ARTIST_INTENT, IDENTITY_FIT, CATALOG_RELATION and TARGET_FIT remain distinct
only current non-inferred evidence may support bounded current decisions
stale and unknown evidence remains visible but cannot silently drive current priority
conflicting current evidence remains explicit rather than collapsed into a score
subjective artist intent or identity truth cannot be certified by measured or external sources
same-band Songs remain semantic ties and Song-ID ordering is serialization only
HOLD preserves option value and is not rejection
RELEASE_PREP and PITCH_PREP do not grant release, publication, submission, placement or provider authority
release, pitch and external-action authority remain hard-false
remaining_semantics: full REQ-SCOPE-127 completion beyond the reusable prioritization foundation
